name: Atelier
subtitle: Atelier's own releases.
description: Releases of Atelier, the on-device app signer. Add this source to get Atelier updates.

apps.name: Atelier
apps.subtitle: Sign and install apps on your iPhone.
apps.localizedDescription: Atelier downloads, signs and installs apps from AltStore-compatible sources with your own certificate, all on the device.

versions.localizedDescription: Atelier is now open source, at github.com/atelierstore/Atelier, and its updates, website and install server moved to atelierstore.app. Apps signed with an Apple ID keep their App Groups, so a widget or extension shares its app's data again.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Atelier uses the camera to scan QR codes for sources.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Atelier pairs with this iPhone over the local network, and installs apps through that pairing.

news.title: Atelier 0.6.0-alpha is out
news.caption: Atelier is now open source, at github.com/atelierstore/Atelier, and its updates, website and install server moved to atelierstore.app. Apps signed with an Apple ID keep their App Groups, so a widget or extension shares its app's data again.
